comment_overall: This file is a template for creating new book content. Each book should be in its own JSON file and listed in the 'bookFiles' array in 'data.json'.
comment_id: A unique identifier for the book, e.g., 'book1', 'book2'. This is used to link questions to the book.

title.comment_title: The title of the book in both English and Arabic.

sections.comment_section: A section can be either a study subject or a quiz. The 'id' determines its type.
sections.comment_section_id: Unique ID for the section within this book. 'bX' for book X, 'sY' for subject Y. Example: 'b1s1', 'b1s2'.

title.ar: عنوان الموضوع Y من الكتاب X

questions.comment_question: Each object in this array is a single question.
questions.comment_uid: CRITICAL: The Unique Identifier for the question. Structure: 'B' + Book# (t) + MWA_Letter (m) + Task# (Y) + 'q' + Question# (W). Example for Book 1, MWA A, Task A1.01, Question 1 would be 'B1AA1.01q1'. This structure is essential for filtering and reporting.

question.en: This is the English version of the question text.
question.ar: هذه هي النسخة العربية من نص السؤال.

questions.comment_correctAnswerIndex: The index of the correct answer in the 'choices' array. It is zero-based (0 for A, 1 for B, 2 for C, 3 for D).

explanation.comment_explanation: Explanations support rich formatting. Provide at least a plain summary and, when possible, a structured richText array to enable headings, lists, emphasis, and coloured text.

en.plain: Detailed explanation for why the correct answer is correct, in English.

richText.content: Begin with a short overview that states the key reason this option is correct. Use bold, italic, or underline for emphasis when needed.

items: Break the explanation into digestible points to help apprentices review each idea quickly.

items.content: Call out exact specifications with colour when required, e.g. torque to 45 Nm.

richText.title: Safety Reminder
richText.content: Always disconnect the battery before working on electrical components.

ar.plain: شرح موجز يوضح سبب صحة الإجابة باللغة العربية.

richText.content: ابدأ بملخص قصير يوضح السبب الرئيسي للاختيار الصحيح مع إمكانية استخدام تنسيق للتأكيد.

items: قسِّم الشرح إلى نقاط مختصرة وواضحة.

items.content: يمكن تمييز الأرقام أو القيم المهمة بالألوان، مثل 45 نيوتن متر.

classification.comment_classification: These codes MUST correspond to the keys in the 'codebook' section of 'data.json' for correct reporting.

questions.comment_type: The 'type' field should correspond to a key in the 'qTypes' object in 'data.json' (e.g., 'knowledge', 'procedural').

sections.comment_quiz_section: For quizzes, the section 'id' MUST start with 'qz'. Example: 'b1qz1'.

title.ar: عنوان الاختبار Y من الكتاب X

questions.comment_quiz_uid: It's good practice to add a suffix like '_quiz' to distinguish quiz questions if they are duplicates of study questions, but it's not required.
